results.statement: X_h has an exact move update X_h'=X_h xor h_c xor(h_c+1), but the action transition additionally needs the current height h_c of the chosen column; X_h,p alone are not a closed transition state.
X_h,p are invariant under column relabeling and therefore constant on q_Sigma orbits. They do not encode the transporter or select a representative.
F cannot be determined from support alone in the tested carriers; transition sufficiency requires residual/action interface information independent of support algebra.

F(E1(q)) and RFGH(q) can have different residual normal forms while inducing one identical tested state partition. Transition-state identity should therefore be phrased at quotient relation level rather than byte/token equality.
The 836 old recursive ambiguities survive every support-only refinement because both parent and successor support are already identical inside each failure fiber.
